<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Lesson path — JongCham</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Courier+Prime:wght@400;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#F7F4ED; --sheet:#FFFFFF; --ink:#1C1A15; --body:#4A473F;
    --muted:#857F73; --faint:#AEA89A; --hair:#E1DBCC; --hair-2:#CFC8B6; --track:#E8E2D5;
    --green:#243529; --green-mid:#3E5F48; --green-dark:#16211A;
    --green-soft:#E5EBE4; --green-line:#B2C6B4; --sage:#9CBFA3;
    --brass:#8E6F2A; --brass-soft:#F3EBD8; --brass-line:#E0CFA4; --brass-mid:#C9A44B;
    --apple:#B8433F;
    --type:"Courier Prime","American Typewriter","Courier New",monospace;
    --sans:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
    --e:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
    --pop:cubic-bezier(.34,1.5,.4,1);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:15px;
       line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;padding-bottom:70px}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--type);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:0}
  .col{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
  .path .col{padding:0}

  /* ---------- sticky deck header ---------- */
  .top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:var(--green);color:#F1EEE7;
       border-bottom-left-radius:20px;border-bottom-right-radius:20px}
  .top .col{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:20px 24px}
  .top .back{width:42px;height:42px;border:0;background:rgba(241,238,231,.1);border-radius:10px;
             color:#F1EEE7;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
  .top .t{flex:1;min-width:0}
  .top .lab{font-family:var(--type);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;
            text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(241,238,231,.45);display:block}
  .top h1{font-size:22px;color:#fff;margin-top:4px}
  .top .stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--type);font-size:19px;
             font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex:none}

  /* ---------- unit banner ---------- */
  .unit{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:26px 0 8px}
  .unit .line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--hair)}
  .unit .name{font-family:var(--type);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;
              text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);text-align:center}
  .unit .name b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--green);letter-spacing:-.02em;
                text-transform:none;margin-top:2px}

  /* ---------- the winding path ---------- */
  .path{position:relative;padding:56px 0 20px;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto}

  /* the scenery sits behind everything */
  .scene{position:absolute;inset:-20px -90px 0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;
         border-radius:24px}
  .scene svg{position:absolute;left:0;width:100%;display:block}

  /* the dotted trail that joins the nodes */
  .trail{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
  .trail path{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.55);stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round;
              stroke-dasharray:2 22}
  .trail path.walked{stroke:#FFFFFF;stroke-dasharray:2 22;opacity:.95}

  .node,.mascot{position:relative;z-index:2}
  .node.open{z-index:25}
  .node.open .cap{transform:translateY(3px)}
  .node.open .cap-label,.node.open .bubble{opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s var(--e)}
  .node.open .disc{box-shadow:0 7px 0 #C3BCAA}

  .node{position:relative;width:132px;height:132px;margin:0 auto 62px;display:block;
        border:0;background:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
  .node:focus-visible{outline:none}
  .node:focus-visible .disc{box-shadow:0 10px 0 #C3BCAA, 0 0 0 4px #fff}
  /* each node is nudged left or right to make the路 wind */
  .node[data-off="0"]{transform:translateX(0)}
  .node[data-off="1"]{transform:translateX(150px)}
  .node[data-off="2"]{transform:translateX(238px)}
  .node[data-off="3"]{transform:translateX(150px)}
  .node[data-off="-1"]{transform:translateX(-150px)}
  .node[data-off="-2"]{transform:translateX(-238px)}
  .node[data-off="-3"]{transform:translateX(-150px)}

  /* the 3D disc: a dark base with a coloured top that presses down */
  .disc{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:#DCD6C7;
        box-shadow:0 10px 0 #C3BCAA}
  /* a thick ring sits around the disc while its card is open */
  .node::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;
               border:9px solid transparent;transition:border-color .2s var(--e);
               pointer-events:none}
  .node.open::after{border-color:rgba(36,53,41,.22)}
  .cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:100%;border-radius:50%;
       display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;
       background:var(--green);box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18);
       transition:transform .12s var(--e)}
  .node:active .cap{transform:translateY(8px)}
  .node:active .disc{box-shadow:0 3px 0 #C3BCAA}

  /* states */
  .node.done .cap{background:linear-gradient(#5FA96D,#4A8C57)}
  .node.now  .cap{background:linear-gradient(#3E8F52,#2C6E3D)}
  .node.lock .cap{background:#D9D3C5;color:#A9A294;box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
  .node.lock .disc{box-shadow:0 10px 0 #C6BFB0}
  .node.chest .cap{background:linear-gradient(#F0C255,#D9A22F);box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
  .node.exam  .cap{background:linear-gradient(#E0605A,#C2453F);box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
  .node.lock{cursor:pointer}

  /* the pulsing ring on the current lesson */
  .node.now::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-17px;border-radius:50%;
                    border:4px solid #FFFFFF;opacity:.9;
                    animation:ring 2.1s ease-out infinite}
  @keyframes ring{0%{transform:scale(.92);opacity:.9}70%{transform:scale(1.14);opacity:0}100%{opacity:0}}

  /* progress ring drawn around a finished lesson */
  .ring{position:absolute;inset:-11px;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
  .ring circle{fill:none;stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round}
  .ring .bg{stroke:var(--hair)}
  .ring .fg{stroke:#F0C255}

  /* the START / bubble above the current node */
  .bubble{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-70px;transform:translateX(-50%);
          background:var(--sheet);border:3px solid var(--green-line);border-radius:14px;
          padding:10px 20px;font-family:var(--type);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;
          letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);white-space:nowrap;
          animation:bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
  .bubble::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-10px;transform:translateX(-50%);
                 width:16px;height:16px;background:var(--sheet);border-right:3px solid var(--green-line);
                 border-bottom:3px solid var(--green-line);rotate:45deg}
  @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-5px)}}

  /* the label under each node */
  .cap-label{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-38px;transform:translateX(-50%);
             font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#26402E;white-space:nowrap;
             background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 15px}

  /* the mascot: a little box character standing beside the path */
  .mascot{position:absolute;right:10px;width:170px;animation:float 5.5s ease-in-out infinite}
  .mascot img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1}
  /* a soft shadow so the panda stands on the grass */
  .mascot .shadow{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4px;transform:translateX(-50%);
                  width:64%;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(28,26,21,.18);
                  filter:blur(5px)}
  @keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}

  /* ---------- the card that opens under a node ---------- */
  .card{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 22px);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.9);
    z-index:20;width:330px;padding:22px 22px 20px;border-radius:22px;color:#fff;text-align:left;
    background:linear-gradient(#3E8F52,#2F7241);box-shadow:0 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16);
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform-origin:50% -10%;
    transition:opacity .2s var(--e),transform .3s var(--pop);
  }
  .node.open .card{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}
  /* the arrow pointing up at the node */
  .card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-11px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
                width:26px;height:26px;background:#3E8F52;border-radius:4px}

  .card.gold{background:linear-gradient(#F0C255,#D9A22F);box-shadow:0 10px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
  .card.gold::before{background:#F0C255}
  .card.red{background:linear-gradient(#E0605A,#C2453F)}
  .card.red::before{background:#E0605A}
  .card.grey{background:linear-gradient(#CFC8B8,#B9B1A0)}
  .card.grey::before{background:#CFC8B8}

  .card h3{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;
           color:#fff;margin:0 0 16px;line-height:1.3}


  /* the white start button, like the reference */
  .card .go{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
            width:100%;height:60px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#FFFFFF;
            font:inherit;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
            text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;color:#4CA45F;
            box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16);transition:all .12s var(--e)}
  .card .go:hover:not(:disabled){background:#FBFFFB}
  .card.gold .go{color:#8A6413}
  .card.red  .go{color:#A63833}
  .card .go:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
  .card.grey .go{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);color:#6E695E;cursor:not-allowed;
                 box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
  /* the XP part sits in the same green, slightly lighter */
  .card .go .xp{color:#4CA45F;font-weight:700}
  .card.gold .go{color:#A87A16}
  .card.gold .go .xp{color:#C9A44B}
  .card.red .go{color:#C2453F}
  .card.red .go .xp{color:#D9736E}


  /* end of section */
  .finish{text-align:center;padding:30px 0 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}

  @media (max-width:760px){
    .node{width:96px;height:96px;margin-bottom:44px}
    .node[data-off="1"],.node[data-off="3"]{transform:translateX(72px)}
    .node[data-off="2"]{transform:translateX(108px)}
    .node[data-off="-1"],.node[data-off="-3"]{transform:translateX(-72px)}
    .node[data-off="-2"]{transform:translateX(-108px)}
    .mascot{width:110px}
    .card{width:250px}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ header ============ -->
<header class="top">
  <div class="col">
    <button class="back" aria-label="Back">
      <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 12H5M11 5l-6 7 6 7"/></svg>
    </button>
    <span class="t">
      <span class="lab">Biology Set · BIO-6620</span>
      <h1>Unit 2 · The cell</h1>
    </span>
    <span class="stat">
      <svg width="17" height="21" viewBox="0 0 32 40"><g transform="translate(16 39) scale(.9) translate(-16 -39)"><path d="M16 39c-6.6 0-12-4.7-12-11.1 0-4.6 2.6-8.3 5.2-11.6C12 12.8 14.6 9.4 14.2 4c1.9 1.1 3.6 2.6 5 4.4 2.1 2.6 3.5 5.6 4.2 8.6.9-1.1 1.5-2.5 1.6-4.2C27.3 16 28 20.4 28 24.5 28 32.2 23 39 16 39Z" fill="#D4703C"/><path d="M16 35.5c-2.9 0-5.2-2.1-5.2-4.9 0-2.2 1.4-3.7 2.6-5.3 1.1-1.5 1.9-2.9 1.7-4.9 2.6 1.5 4.4 3.7 5.1 6 .4-.6.6-1.3.7-2.1 1 1.7 1.5 3.6 1.5 5.3 0 3.6-2.4 5.9-6.4 5.9Z" fill="#F0B44F"/></g></svg>
      32
    </span>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="col">
  <div class="path" id="path"></div>
  <p class="finish">Unit 3 opens when you pass the unit exam.</p>
</div>

<script>
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

  /* ---------- the path ---------- */
  const STEPS = [
    { k:"lesson", state:"done", off:0,  n:"Lesson 1", h:"What a cell is",
      d:"Ten cards on the building block of every living thing.", cards:10, score:100 },
    { k:"lesson", state:"done", off:-2, n:"Lesson 2", h:"Plant and animal cells",
      d:"Twelve cards on what makes the two kinds different.", cards:12, score:88 },
    { k:"chest",  state:"done", off:-3, n:"Reward",   h:"Apple chest",
      d:"You finished two lessons in a row — take three apples.", cards:0, score:0 },
    { k:"lesson", state:"now",  off:0,  n:"Lesson 3", h:"Compare travel experiences",
      d:"Twelve cards on comparing places, prices and journeys.", cards:12, score:0 },
    { k:"lesson", state:"lock", off:2,  n:"Lesson 4", h:"Photosynthesis",
      d:"Fourteen cards on how a plant turns light into food.", cards:14, score:0 },
    { k:"chest",  state:"lock", off:3,  n:"Reward",   h:"Apple chest",
      d:"Finish lesson 4 to open it.", cards:0, score:0 },
    { k:"lesson", state:"lock", off:0,  n:"Lesson 5", h:"Cell division",
      d:"Twelve cards on mitosis, step by step.", cards:12, score:0 },
    { k:"exam",   state:"lock", off:-2, n:"Unit exam", h:"The cell",
      d:"Twenty timed questions. Pass at 70% for your certificate.", cards:20, score:0 }
  ];

  /* the card that opens under a node */
  function cardFor(s, i){
    const tone = s.state === "lock" ? "grey"
               : s.k === "chest" ? "gold"
               : s.k === "exam"  ? "red" : "";
    const xp = s.k === "exam" ? 50 : s.k === "chest" ? 0 : 10;

    /* one short line only — cards, or the score, never both */
    const line =
      s.state === "lock" ? "Finish the step before this one"
      : s.k === "chest"  ? "3 apples inside"
      : s.k === "exam"   ? `${s.cards} questions · 70% to pass`
      : s.score          ? `${s.cards} cards · best ${s.score}%`
      : `${s.cards} cards · about 6 min`;

    const label =
      s.state === "lock" ? "Locked" :
      s.k === "chest"    ? `Open <span class="xp">+5 XP</span>` :
      s.k === "exam"     ? `Start exam <span class="xp">+${xp} XP</span>` :
      s.state === "done" ? `Practise <span class="xp">+5 XP</span>` :
                           `Start <span class="xp">+${xp} XP</span>`;

    return `
      <div class="card ${tone}" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
        <h3>${s.h}</h3>
        <button class="go" ${s.state === "lock" ? "disabled" : ""}>${label}</button>
      </div>`;
  }

  const ICONS = {
    lesson:`<svg width="54" height="54" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2.6l2.9 5.9 6.5.9-4.7 4.6 1.1 6.5-5.8-3-5.8 3 1.1-6.5L2.6 9.4l6.5-.9z"/></svg>`,
    chest:`<svg width="50" height="50" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 10a9 9 0 0 1 18 0v9a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1Z"/><path d="M3 13h18" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="10" y="11.5" width="4" height="4.5" rx="1.4" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>`,
    exam:`<svg width="50" height="50" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="9" r="5.5"/><path d="M8.5 13.5 7 22l5-2.5L17 22l-1.5-8.5"/></svg>`,
    lock:`<svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="4" y="10" width="16" height="10" rx="2.5"/><path d="M8 10V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3"/></svg>`
  };

  /* ---------- the landscape behind the path ---------- */
  const scenery = `
    <div class="scene" id="scene">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 400 900" preserveAspectRatio="none" style="height:100%">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stop-color="#CFE3EF"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#EAF1E6"/>
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="g1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8FBF9C"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6FA87E"/>
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="g2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stop-color="#A8D2A9"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#87BE8C"/>
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="g3" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stop-color="#C2E0BC"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#A3CFA2"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>

        <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="330" fill="url(#sky)"/>

        <circle cx="322" cy="72" r="30" fill="#FBE0A0"/>
        <circle cx="322" cy="72" r="20" fill="#F7CE6E"/>

        <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9">
          <ellipse cx="86" cy="70" rx="26" ry="14"/><ellipse cx="108" cy="64" rx="20" ry="16"/>
          <ellipse cx="64" cy="76" rx="18" ry="11"/>
          <ellipse cx="248" cy="118" rx="22" ry="12"/><ellipse cx="266" cy="112" rx="16" ry="13"/>
        </g>

        <path d="M0 210 Q60 150 120 196 T250 186 T400 214 V330 H0Z" fill="#B9D9C4"/>
        <path d="M-10 300 L70 168 L124 246 L176 142 L250 300Z" fill="#7E9DB4"/>
        <path d="M176 142 L206 186 L186 214 L200 246 L250 300Z" fill="#6A88A0"/>
        <path d="M58 198 L70 168 L84 198 Q70 208 58 198Z" fill="#F6FAFC"/>
        <path d="M164 168 L176 142 L190 170 Q176 180 164 168Z" fill="#F6FAFC"/>
        <path d="M230 330 L300 208 L352 288 L410 330Z" fill="#7E9DB4"/>
        <path d="M290 228 L300 208 L312 230 Q300 238 290 228Z" fill="#F6FAFC"/>

        <path d="M0 300 Q100 268 200 296 T400 286 V560 H0Z" fill="url(#g1)"/>
        <path d="M0 520 Q120 486 240 516 T400 500 V760 H0Z" fill="url(#g2)"/>
        <path d="M0 720 Q110 690 230 716 T400 704 V900 H0Z" fill="url(#g3)"/>

        <path d="M-20 420 Q90 448 150 500 T280 596 T430 660" fill="none" stroke="#7FB6D6"
              stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".75"/>
        <path d="M-20 420 Q90 448 150 500 T280 596 T430 660" fill="none" stroke="#A9D4EC"
              stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>

        ${[[70,364,"#E5738C"],[318,392,"#F2C14E"],[112,556,"#E5738C"],
           [300,660,"#C583D6"],[64,760,"#F2C14E"],[336,796,"#E5738C"],
           [190,470,"#F2C14E"],[248,760,"#C583D6"]].map(([x,y,c]) => `
          <g transform="translate(${x} ${y})">
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3.4" fill="${c}"/>
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.3" fill="#FFF6D8"/>
            <path d="M0 3 v6" stroke="#4E8A56" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          </g>`).join("")}
      </svg>

      <svg viewBox="0 0 400 900" preserveAspectRatio="none" style="height:100%">
        ${[[26,346,1,"round"],[360,330,.9,"pine"],[50,508,.85,"pine"],[356,540,1.05,"round"],
           [20,724,.95,"round"],[368,752,.85,"pine"],[92,300,.7,"round"],[306,300,.72,"pine"]]
          .map(([x,y,k,kind]) => kind === "pine" ? `
          <g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${k})">
            <rect x="-3.5" y="0" width="7" height="22" rx="3" fill="#8A6A46"/>
            <path d="M0 -46 L17 -14 H-17Z" fill="#3F7A4C"/>
            <path d="M0 -32 L21 4 H-21Z" fill="#4C8C58"/>
            <path d="M0 -18 L24 20 H-24Z" fill="#5C9E67"/>
          </g>` : `
          <g transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(${k})">
            <rect x="-3.5" y="-4" width="7" height="26" rx="3" fill="#8A6A46"/>
            <circle cx="0" cy="-18" r="20" fill="#5C9E67"/>
            <circle cx="-14" cy="-6" r="14" fill="#4C8C58"/>
            <circle cx="14" cy="-7" r="13" fill="#6EB177"/>
            <circle cx="-6" cy="-24" r="4.5" fill="#E2574F"/>
            <circle cx="9" cy="-16" r="4" fill="#E2574F"/>
          </g>`).join("")}

        ${[[96,430,"#5C9E67"],[300,640,"#4C8C58"],[126,822,"#6EB177"],[292,232,"#5C9E67"]]
          .map(([x,y,c]) => `
          <g transform="translate(${x} ${y})">
            <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="15" ry="10" fill="${c}"/>
            <ellipse cx="-7" cy="-4" rx="9" ry="7" fill="${c}" opacity=".75"/>
          </g>`).join("")}

        ${[[64,600],[336,470],[176,832]].map(([x,y]) => `
          <g transform="translate(${x} ${y})">
